subject: MediSphere onboarding: steward assignment & kickoff plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: MediSphere onboarding: initial handoff and implementation materials

Team —

Putting the handoff in your hands for MediSphere (signed yesterday). Quick context: this is a 3-month activation for their primary care offering with an expected go-live target of 2026-12-15. Committed capacity is Dedicated: 2 x A100 equivalent. They selected private deployment into our us-west region with data residency constraints.

What's included here: attached SOW (final v1) and the network requirements workbook. Open items you should be aware of:
- DocuSign still pending (I attached the signed sales contract; the SOW is in the pipeline).
- They require SOC 2 attestation + specific logging evidence (see red highlight in SOW).
- IP allowlist entries for their VPC team — they need the NAT IPs from infra; ask Dev for the list.

Asks for CS:
1) Assign primary CS owner and technical owner for integrations by EOD today.
2) Propose an internal pre-kickoff (30-45m) to review risks and the integration checklist — target early next week.
3) Confirm training cadence they want (we recommended two 2-hour sessions).

Attachments: MediSphere_SOW_v1.pdf, network_requirements.xlsx, onboarding_checklist.csv

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MediSphere onboarding: initial handoff and implementation materials

Thanks Ben — appreciate the context. Assigning owners and next steps below.

Owners (confirmed):
- Primary CS Owner: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer) — will lead kickoff + post-sign success plan.
- Success Manager (customer-facing day-to-day): Marissa Cole (marissa_cole).
- Integration / Infra Owner: Dev Patel (dev_patel) — will handle IP allowlist, VPN/VPC networking, and staging infra.

High-level plan / immediate actions:
1) Karthik & Marissa: internal pre-kickoff (30m) Monday 11/23 @10:00am PT — review SOW acceptance criteria, training schedule, and escalation path.
2) Dev: gather the NAT/IP ranges and confirm whether MediSphere needs a customer-managed VPN or we should broker the connection (include estimated lead times).
3) Documentation: I'll prepare a short runbook (internal) that lists acceptance gates and who signs them off.

Risks / blockers to flag to the customer during kickoff:
- SOC 2 evidence: procurement wants a timeline for evidence delivery; we may need Legal/Security to provide extracts.
- Data migration: MediSphere indicated an existing SQL dump; we need clarity on schema compatibility and volume (estimate: ~150GB).
- Go-live buffer: recommend pushing target to 2026-12-20 if migration complexity emerges.

I will draft the outgoing kickoff invite to MediSphere once we sync. Anything else I should include in the pre-kickoff agenda?

Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success (Enterprise) | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (646) 555-0147

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Rao <anika@medisphere.health>, Tom Bell <tom.bell@medisphere.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: MediSphere onboarding: proposed kickoff dates and checklist

Hi Anika / Tom —

Congrats again on getting to signed — excited to get started. I'm Grace on the Customer Success team and I'll be your primary contact for onboarding. Quick note on timeline and asks so we can align calendars:

Proposed kickoff (60 min):
- Option A: Thu, Dec 2 @ 9:00am PT
- Option B: Fri, Dec 3 @ 10:00am PT

Agenda (high level):
- Introductions & roles
- Review SOW acceptance criteria + go-live definition
- Network & infra checklist (IP allowlist, VPN plan)
- Data migration plan & timing
- Training schedule & success metrics
- Next steps / action owners + dates

Pre-kickoff items we need from you before the meeting:
1) Confirm internal attendees and their roles (product, infra, security).
2) Share the existing SQL dump size and expected delivery window (if migration is needed).
3) Confirm whether your security team requires a SOC 2 package or additional controls evidence.

DocuSign: SOW pending signature — I included the DocuSign link here: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/RDW-2026-0457
Join link for the kickoff (tentative): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=handoff123

Attachments: MediSphere_SOW_v1.pdf (for your convenience)

Let me know which kickoff option works and who else should be on the invite.

Best,
Grace

From: Anika Rao <anika@medisphere.health>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Bell <tom.bell@medisphere.health>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MediSphere onboarding: proposed kickoff dates and checklist

Grace —

Thanks and congrats to the Redwood team on moving this through. Option A (Thu, Dec 2 @ 9:00am PT) works for us. Confirmed internal attendees:
- Tom Bell — Head of Platform (technical lead)
- Anika Rao — Product Lead (owner of acceptance criteria)
- Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@medisphere.health> — Data Migration Lead
- Elias Cruz <elias.cruz@medisphere.health> — Security

Data migration window: initial SQL dump ready by Dec 6 (approx 150GB). We plan a dry-run week of Dec 13 to validate load performance.

SOC 2: our security team will need the SOC 2 extract + network design diagrams (we can share specifics in kickoff).

Two quick asks:
1) Do you have a standard training deck for administrators vs end-users?
2) Can Redwood provide a temporary staging environment credentials for our migration dry-run?

We'll sign the SOW by Monday — sending to our procurement for final stamp.

Thanks,
Anika Rao
Product Lead | MediSphere Health
anika@medisphere.health | +1 (617) 555-0210

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Rao <anika@medisphere.health>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MediSphere onboarding: proposed kickoff dates and checklist

Appreciate the quick reply, Anika — Dec 2 @ 9:00am PT is locked. I will run the kickoff and capture the action items. Quick responses to your asks:

1) Training: yes — we have a standard admin + end-user deck. I'll attach the admin deck to the kickoff calendar invite and we can tailor it to MediSphere's workflows.
2) Staging creds: Dev, can you provision a temporary staging tenant and create a migration user for MediSphere (150GB target) ahead of Dec 13 dry-run? Estimate: 2 business days after request for credentials + baseline test data.

Action owners (summary):
- Karthik: kickoff lead, acceptance criteria tracker
- Marissa: training lead, post-kick go-live support runbook
- Dev: infra/staging + NAT/IP ranges for allowlist

I'll send the formal calendar invite and attach the pre-kickoff checklist. Looking forward to getting this moving.

- Karthik
